title: Lowercase Commands
description: Forces all slash-prefixed commands typed in chat to be lowercase.
body:
Lowercase Commands is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that automatically converts any slash-prefixed text in Minecraft command boxes to lowercase. For example, /GAMEMODE CREATIVE becomes /gamemode creative, and inputs like /GIVE, /Tp, and /HeLp become /give, /tp, and /help before the game uses or renders the text. It only affects inputs that start with /, so normal 
chat text and other UI fields stay unchanged.
